cooper.name: Dan Cooper (FBI composite)
cooper.look: man in his mid-40s, about 5'10" to 6', olive complexion, brown eyes, short black hair, dark business suit, white shirt, thin black clip-on tie with pearl tie pin, dark raincoat, dark sunglasses

schaffner.name: Florence Schaffner
schaffner.look: 23-year-old flight attendant in a 1971 Northwest Orient uniform

scenes.text: On November 24th, 1971, a quiet man in a dark suit bought a one-way plane ticket under the name Dan Cooper.
scenes.shot: Portland airport ticket counter at night in 1971, the man paying cash, rain on the windows
scenes.motion: slow push-in, man slides cash across the counter, rain streaks on glass

scenes.text: Shortly after takeoff, he handed the flight attendant a note. It said he had a bomb.
scenes.shot: inside a 1971 Boeing 727 cabin, the man seated in the last row handing a folded note to a flight attendant
scenes.motion: note passes between hands, attendant's expression turns to fear

scenes.text: He opened his briefcase. Inside were wires and red sticks.
scenes.shot: close-up of an open briefcase on a lap showing wires and red cylinders, dim cabin light
scenes.motion: briefcase lid slowly opens, camera tilts down into it

scenes.text: His demands were simple. Two hundred thousand dollars and four parachutes.
scenes.shot: the man writing on a napkin with sunglasses on, calm expression, cigarette smoke
scenes.motion: smoke drifts, subtle head turn toward camera

scenes.text: In Seattle, the FBI delivered the money. Cooper let all thirty-six passengers go.
scenes.shot: rainy night tarmac at Seattle airport, a 727 with its rear stairs down, passengers walking away under floodlights
scenes.motion: passengers walk off, rain falls through floodlights

scenes.text: Then, somewhere over the forests of Washington, in the dark and the rain, he lowered the rear stairs and jumped.
scenes.shot: a man with a parachute pack standing on the lowered rear airstair of a 727 in flight at night, storm clouds, forest far below
scenes.motion: wind whips his tie and coat, he steps off into darkness

scenes.text: He was never seen again. Nine years later, a boy playing on the banks of the Columbia River dug up five thousand eight hundred dollars of the ransom.
scenes.shot: a boy kneeling on a sandy riverbank uncovering decayed bundles of 20 dollar bills, overcast sky
scenes.motion: boy brushes sand off the money bundles

scenes.text: To this day, nobody knows who Dan Cooper really was.
scenes.shot: the FBI composite sketch of the man pinned to a corkboard among case files and maps, single desk lamp
